result.recoveredFact: The recovered LWBridge Map Data resource renderer derives Gathering versus Idle solely from nonempty/nonzero gatherMarchUuid or gatherUid. If both are absent, it renders Idle.
result.sourceLimit: The bounded current_live_resource_probe.lua resource_point capture does not acquire gatherMarchUuid, gatherUid or another authoritative occupancy field. Their absence therefore cannot prove Idle.
implementationPolicy: FirstLiveResultImporter adds rebuildGatherOccupancyKnown=false only to bounded imported current-view resource rows.
The generated frontend renders an em dash for resource status only when that explicit rebuild-only flag is false.
Rows without the rebuild-only flag keep the recovered original Idle/Gathering behavior.
The saved replay no longer relies on a coordinate-specific DOM mutation for occupancy; replay and normal bounded live rows now share the same data-driven unknown-state handling.
